title: PermissionRuleFinding
description: One thing the redundancy/overlap/conflict analysis says about a rule or a draft, against the caller's active rules (plan 15, B-15).

ruleIds.description: The other rules the finding is about, besides the one it is attached to — empty for a finding that is about that rule alone (`tooBroad`, `unreachable`).

params.description: The parameters of the message — an open object, as every other `messageKey`/`params` pair in this contract.
